sentences.text: This bird is distinguished by a shortened second metatarsal bone that lacks a specific muscle attachment point, while its fourth toe bone is the longest in the foot rather than the third.
Although first mentioned in a 2008 review, the genus was formally named by Gareth J. Dyke and Attila Ősi in 2010 after the Bauxite mine where fossils were found.
The specific name mindszentyae honors Andrea Mindszenty, who served as the advisor to Attila Ősi.
Bauxitornis belongs to the subclass Enantiornithes and is classified within the family Avisauridae.
While usually classified as an avisaurid enantiornithean, some studies suggest it is a basal avialan related to Balaur bondoc.
Bauxitornis lived between 85.7 and 83.6 million years ago during the Santonian stage.
